description: This source file defines the SQSBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for managing batches of SQS messages in an Orleans streaming application. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, and handling of event sequences within SQS message batches.

classes.name: SQSBatchContainer
classes.description: A container class for batching SQS messages in Orleans streams, capable of serialization, deserialization, and sequence management.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns the events contained in the batch, cast to the specified type, along with their sequence tokens.

methods.name: ToSQSMessage
methods.description: Serializes the batch container and constructs a SendMessageRequest for SQS.

methods.name: FromSQSMessage
methods.description: Deserializes an SQS message into an SQSBatchContainer instance and assigns the message and sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into the current execution context, if available.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container, including stream ID and item count.
